Problem Statement:
🐛 Fix validation error when `File` is declared after `Form` parameter

This PR updates the fix (6185a92) from @jsg921019 so that tests pass with the latest FastAPI code (0.110.0).

When declaring an endpoint which accepts a `File` but also a `Form` parameter, the `File` parameter must be declared first or the endpoint would respond with error 422.

The issue was caused by a bug in `fastapi/dependencies/utils.py` within the `_extract_form_body` function. The code was incorrectly relying on the type of the first field in the request body (`first_field_info`) to determine whether to read `UploadFile` objects when the field was typed as `bytes` or a sequence of `bytes`. This meant that if a `Form` parameter preceded a `File` parameter typed as `bytes`, the file content was not read, leading to a Pydantic validation error (HTTP 422) because an `UploadFile` object was passed instead of the expected `bytes`.

I fixed this by removing the dependency on `first_field_info` and instead checking the properties of each field individually. Now, if a field is typed as `bytes` (or a sequence of `bytes`) and the received value is an `UploadFile` (or a sequence of `UploadFile`s), the content is correctly read and provided to Pydantic. I verified the fix with reproduction scripts covering various combinations of `Form` and `File` parameters.
